query:
WITH hits (by_show, item_id, rank) AS (
                           SELECT 0, rowid, rank FROM title_search WHERE title_search MATCH ?1
                           UNION ALL
                           SELECT 1, rowid, rank FROM title_search WHERE title_search MATCH ?2
                       ),
                       titled AS (
                           SELECT hits.by_show, hits.item_id, hits.rank,
                                  matched_items.library_id AS library, matched_items.own_id,
                                  matched_items.listed_id,
                                  iif(hits.by_show, matched_items.listed_id, matched_items.own_id)
                                      AS title_key
                           FROM hits
                           JOIN (SELECT library_files.library_id, library_items.id AS item_id, library_items.kind,
                      library_files.path, library_items.season, library_items.episode,
                      library_items.added_at, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = 'title') AS own_id, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS listed_id
               FROM item_matches
               JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
               JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
               JOIN libraries ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
               WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched'
                 AND library_items.kind = IIF(libraries.kind = 'movies', 'movie', 'episode')
                 AND own_id IS NOT NULL AND listed_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND (library_items.kind = 'movie'
                      OR (library_items.season IS NOT NULL
                          AND library_items.episode IS NOT NULL))) AS matched_items ON matched_items.item_id = hits.item_id
                           WHERE iif(matched_items.kind = 'movie', ?3, ?4)
                             -- A Movie's `listed_id` is its own, so a Show title its Match
                             -- holds mustn't make it a Show.
                             AND (NOT hits.by_show OR matched_items.kind = 'episode')
                       ),
                       grouped AS (
                           SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
                               PARTITION BY by_show, library, title_key ORDER BY rank, item_id
                           ) AS nth
                           FROM titled
                       ),
                       best AS (
                           SELECT by_show, item_id, rank, library, title_key, own_id, listed_id
                           FROM grouped WHERE nth = 1
                           ORDER BY rank, by_show, item_id
                           LIMIT ?5
                       )
                       SELECT best.library AS "library!", best.by_show AS "by_show!: bool",
                              best.rank AS "rank!: f64", best.own_id AS "own_id!: String",
                              best.listed_id AS "listed_id!: String",
                              library_items.kind AS "kind: ItemKind", library_items.season,
                              library_items.episode, (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = 'title') AS "ids?: String", (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = 'show') AS "show_ids?: String", item_matches.title AS "title!",
                              item_matches.show_title, item_matches.release_date,
                              item_matches.poster, item_matches.poster_plugin,
                              item_matches.show_poster, item_matches.show_poster_plugin,
                              item_matches.metadata_version,
                              iif(best.by_show, (
                                  SELECT json_group_array(json_array(
                                      library_items.season, item_matches.poster,
                                      item_matches.poster_plugin))
                                  FROM grouped
                                  JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = grouped.item_id
                                  JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = grouped.item_id
                                  WHERE grouped.by_show AND grouped.library = best.library
                                    AND grouped.title_key = best.title_key
                              )) AS "seasons?: String"
                       FROM best
                       JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = best.item_id
                       JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = best.item_id
                       ORDER BY best.rank, best.by_show, best.item_id
